comparison.objective: Compress a twelve-cell pack and capture preload with a cross-key; candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Maintain distributed axial preload while inserting a transverse retainer versus maintain angular setting while tightening a concentric nut.
comparison.success_condition: All cells retained under correct preload after release versus gripper angle retained through repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: This is a related bimanual load-transfer pattern, but cross-key preload capture and jam-nut countertorque are meaningfully different mechanisms.
